tickets.title: US003: Request Prerequisite Override
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to submit a prerequisite override request directly from the planner when blocked from adding a course, so that my academic advisor can review my special circumstances.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: A "Request Override" button appears when a course addition is blocked due to missing prerequisites.
2. Pass/Fail: Submitting the request places the course in a "Pending Advisor Approval" status on the student's board.
